name: Account-global MCP tool-call timeseries
description: Account-global MCP tool-call timeseries Returns daily or monthly tool-call counts across the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/ai-controls/mcp/analytics/tool-calls/timeseries
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/ai-controls/mcp/analytics/tool-calls/timeseries
Returns daily or monthly tool-call counts across the account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: granularity (query); aggregate (query); tz (query); days (query) — Daily trailing-window size; defaults to 7 and is ignored for monthly

name: Delete an MCP Portal
description: Delete an MCP Portal Deletes an MCP portal from the account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/ai-controls/mcp/portals/{id}

description: Delete an MCP Server Deletes an MCP server from the account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/ai-controls/mcp/servers/{id}

name: Resolve an MCP server OAuth redirect URI
description: Resolve an MCP server OAuth redirect URI Resolves the OAuth redirect URI to register for a portal and server based on the server's current shared callback setting. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/ai-controls/mcp/portals/{portal_id}/servers/{server_id}/effective-redirect-uri
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/ai-controls/mcp/portals/{portal_id}/servers/{server_id}/effective-redirect-uri
Resolves the OAuth redirect URI to register for a portal and server based on the server's current shared callback setting. Use the returned value when setting up a new manual OAuth registration. This value is for display only: existing manual OAuth registrations continue using their stored redirect URI, so changing callback settings can make this result differ from the URI used at runtime.
Required: portal_id (path); server_id (path); account_id (path)
